Earth.en: The Earth is our only home in the whole universe.
Earth.cn: 地球是我们在整个宇宙中唯一的家。

pollution.en: Cars and factories cause a lot of air pollution.
pollution.cn: 汽车和工厂造成大量空气污染。

recycle.en: We recycle plastic, glass and metal at our school.
recycle.cn: 我们学校回收塑料、玻璃和金属。

plastic.en: Plastic takes hundreds of years to break down.
plastic.cn: 塑料需要几百年才能分解。

tree.en: On Earth Day, we plant new trees in the park.
tree.cn: 地球日我们在公园种新树。

river.en: The river near our school is much cleaner now.
river.cn: 学校附近的河现在干净多了。

protect.en: We must protect the Earth for future generations.
protect.cn: 我们必须为后代保护地球。

save.en: Turning off lights helps save a lot of electricity.
